jobs.title: Lead Sound Designer
jobs.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for an experienced Lead Sound Designer to join our studio in Warsaw to drive audio development of Witcher 4. As a Lead Sound Designer, you will be responsible for leading the Sound Design team and collaborating with cross-discipline teams to create and deliver an immersive audio experience for our upcoming game. If you are an accomplished game audio artist and experienced leader with a passion for crafting soundscapes for widely respected, narrative-driven RPGs, we want to hear from you! Daily Responsibilities: Lead a team of Sound Designers and drive game audio development in the project. Help define and maintain aesthetic continuity throughout the game and trailers, in alignment with previous releases in the IP where appropriate. Collaborate closely with project Directors, Leads, Producers, and cross-discipline teams (Music, VO, Programmers) to craft immersive, high-quality, and technologically advanced audio experiences. Plan, revise, track, and execute milestones, sprints, and roadmap deliverables. Support and coach team members to achieve impactful and high-quality in-game results while fostering their growth and development. Support the design and development of innovative audio systems using Unreal Engine 5, Wwise middleware, and in-house tools. Design, implement, and mix original and rich sound effects. 7+ years of professional experience in the video game industry, with involvement in multiple shipped AAA titles. At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role related to sound design or audio direction. Strong creative skills and a focus on quality, evidenced by a portfolio, demo reel, or game credits. Collaborative approach to navigating challenges and resolving design obstacles. Exceptional artistic and creative competence. Effective cross-disciplinary communication skills. Ability to manage timelines and coordinate with teams. Skilled communicator experienced in collaborating across development teams and providing supportive leadership to direct reports. Nice to Have: (These skills are not required to apply for the position) Experience with Atmos, Surround Sound, 3D Audio, and HRTF. Experience working with performance capture. Experience planning and executing field and Foley recording sessions. Working mode In-office in a hybrid or full-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland. Relocation is required. Relocation Support Relocation package — flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet and family, shipping your belongings. It’s all covered. Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you and  tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Paid Leave — from 20 to 26 days of holiday per year, and paid sick leave. Health & Well-Being Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company. Perks & Professional Growth A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! Social Activities & Life in the Office Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio. Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has  electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog . A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them. An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes. No dress-code — we like to keep it casual. Estimated pay range for this position: 31 800 – 43 725 PLN gross monthly. This role may be eligible for a long term incentive program (option to purchase CDPR stock after the vesting period). Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications. Type of contract: Employment Contract ("Umowa o pracę"). If you've observed any irregularities (i.e. legal or ethical violations) in our recruitment process, please click here to report them anonymously. #LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Suno**
==============

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

**About the Role**
------------------

Our Los Angeles office is home to Suno's largest concentration of musicians, producers, and music-industry partners, and the technology they depend on is different from a typical office: studios, DAWs, audio interfaces, monitoring, high-resolution playback, and the networks and storage that move large sessions around. As Staff IT Engineer, you'll own the audio and studio technology domain for Suno company-wide — designing, building, and supporting the production environments our Music team works in — while also serving as the senior IT presence on the ground in LA.

You'll report to the Senior Manager, IT Operations and work alongside IT Engineers in Cambridge, NYC, and San Francisco, who manage identity, endpoint, SaaS, and office-infrastructure. You'll work with the rest of the team to manage our Corporate IT systems stack, but you'll be our audio and A/V expert.

**Listen to the song we made about it:** https://suno.com/s/ldMCcRAh5ln0LgNA

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Run IT for the LA office** — identity and onboarding, endpoint management, SaaS Administration, wired/wireless networking, zero-trust VPN, and A/V and videoconferencing.
* **Own audio and studio systems as a domain** — set the standard for how Suno builds and supports production spaces across offices: studio and listening-room design in partnership with acousticians and integrators, DAW and plugin management, audio interfaces and I/O, monitoring and calibration, and the storage and networking that production work needs.
* **Support the Music team at a professional bar** — keep sessions running; manage DAW environments (Pro Tools, Logic, Ableton, and others), licensing, plugin fleets, and audio drivers across a Mac fleet; troubleshoot latency, clocking, and routing problems the rest of IT can't.
* **Partner on the product** — work with Engineering and the Suno Studio team to make sure internal creators have the hardware, routing, and environments they need to use and test our tools the way professional producers do.
* **Design for the next space** — specify audio, A/V, and network requirements for LA buildouts and expansions and for studio spaces in other offices; manage integrators and vendors to a result.
* **Scale support** — write runbooks and knowledge articles that let office managers and AI-powered self-service handle the routine, and automate what you've done twice.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

### **Must-Haves**

* 10+ years of IT engineering experience, including significant time supporting professional audio production environments — studios, post-production, broadcast, live, or music-technology companies.
* Deep professional-audio competence — signal flow, digital audio (sample rates, clocking, word clock, Dante or AVB), DAW administration, audio interfaces and converters, monitoring and room calibration — and the ability to diagnose problems producers describe by ear.
* Demonstrated breadth across the IT stack — identity, endpoint, SaaS administration, networking, and office IT — with the depth to operate independently as the only IT engineer in an office.
* Experience owning a technical domain end to end — you've set the standard others follow, not just executed it.
* Strong written and verbal communication — you can work comfortably with producers, engineers, executives, and vendors, and translate between them.
* Learning agility — you pick up new platforms quickly, you're comfortable being the first person at the company to figure something out, and you aren't afraid to ask for help.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Studio design and buildout experience — acoustic treatment, room tuning, patchbay and infrastructure design, working with acousticians and AV integrators.
* Hands-on experience with a modern IdP (Okta or equivalent), modern Apple MDM (Iru, Jamf, Jumpcloud), and endpoint security (CrowdStrike or similar).
* Networking depth — AV-over-IP, multicast, QoS for audio networks, and managed switching.
* Experience supporting creative or music teams at a technology company, or IT at a label, studio, or music-tech company.
* Comfort with at least one scripting language (Python, TypeScript, or Bash) and config-as-code approaches.
* Working knowledge of music production — you've made or recorded music yourself.

**Work Location Policy**
------------------------

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

**Additional Notes**

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Willingness to travel (up to 20%) to collaborate with team members and support studio spaces across Suno office locations.

*

Audio Artist II – Speech Production EA SPORTS™ NHL Who We Are EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games. EA SPORTS NHL has revolutionised sports gaming for millions of players worldwide. We've pioneered award-winning creative technology and experiences to connect players to the speed, skill, and heart of the NHL. Role Overview We are looking for an Audio Artist II to join the EA SPORTS NHL Audio team. The primary focus of this role is mastering, organising, and delivering high-quality recorded speech for commentary, voice-over, and other in-game experiences. You will also support speech-production workflows using AI tools that help the team maintain content at scale. Reporting to the Audio Lead, you will work independently within a defined area, applying editorial judgement and technical discipline to ensure assets meet creative, pipeline, and in-game quality standards. The Challenge Ahead Your challenge will be to turn recorded and generated source material into game-ready assets while maintaining accuracy across naming, metadata, versioning, and delivery. You will review content critically and work with speech leads, audio leadership, production, and technical partners to resolve issues. You will contribute ideas within your area, help improve established workflows, estimate your work with guidance, and communicate status, dependencies, and risks early. Who You Are You are an audio professional with dialogue-editing and mastering skills. You are comfortable working through high volumes of content without losing consistency, and you understand how editorial choices affect clarity, authenticity, and the player experience. You evaluate and integrate new tools through active testing and structured analysis. You will review audio outputs to identify artifacts and inconsistencies, correct manageable issues through direct editing, and escalate complex problems to the speech team. You will maintain structured asset workflows, integrate team reviews into your daily process, and implement solutions to increase our audio processing pipeline's reliability. Responsibilities Master, clean, and quality-check commentary, dialogue, and other speech assets. Use approved speech-generation and processing tools to create or adapt content, then evaluate and prepare outputs to team standards. Identify issues involving noise, level, dynamics, spectral balance, timing, pronunciation, continuity, or processing artifacts. Maintain accurate naming, metadata, versioning, source files, and delivery structures. Prepare, import, and validate speech assets in game-audio tools, databases, and established pipelines. Track assigned work, provide estimates with lead support, and communicate priorities, dependencies, and schedule risks. Participate in troubleshooting and recommend practical improvements to tools and workflows. Document processes and share knowledge. Requirements Professional experience editing and mastering dialogue, commentary, VO, ADR, broadcast, or comparable speech content. Advanced proficiency with Pro Tools or another professional DAW, including dialogue cleanup, EQ, dynamics, noise reduction, loudness control, and batch workflows. Demonstrated experience evaluating audio to identify subtle quality, consistency, and processing errors. 3+ years of experience managing assets against technical specifications, naming conventions, metadata, and version-control requirements. Experience with game-audio authoring tools, databases, or content pipelines. You will document technical workflows, track project milestones, and coordinate asset deliveries across multiple technical and creative departments. Experience with modern speech-production, voice-processing, automation, or scripting workflows is an asset. jobs.title: Concepteur audio technique / Technical Audio Designer
jobs.description: En tant que concepteur audio technique, vous vous situez à l’intersection du design sonore et de l’ingénierie, transformant les éléments audio en systèmes en jeu performants et peaufinés. En collaboration avec les concepteurs sonores, les ingénieurs et les concepteurs techniques, vous intégrerez l’audio dans Unreal Engine et Wwise, concevrez des outils et optimiserez les performances. Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique destiné à une personne souhaitant évoluer à la jonction de la création et de la technique. Contrat de 12 mois Responsabilités: Intégrer les éléments audio dans Unreal Engine à l’aide du moteur sonore Wwise, de l’élément source jusqu’au système jouable. Concevoir et maintenir des systèmes audio basés sur les Blueprints. Développer et améliorer des outils permettant d’accélérer le flux de travail des concepteurs sonores. Profiler et optimiser l’audio en termes de CPU, mémoire, nombre de voix et flux (streaming) à l’aide du Wwise Profiler et d’Unreal Audio Insights. Respecter les directives d’organisation des données et de mixage de Wwise afin de garantir la cohérence du contenu et sa capacité à passer à l’échelle. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes audio en collaboration avec l’équipe de développement. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique des fonctionnalités, outils et flux de travail audio. Communiquer clairement les progrès et les contraintes techniques aux collaborateurs non techniques. Exigences: 3 ans ou plus d’expérience en audio technique, incluant un cycle de production complet jusqu’au lancement du jeu. Compétences démontrables en intégration audio avec Unreal Engine et Wwise. Solide maîtrise des Blueprints Unreal pour l’intégration audio. Maîtrise de Wwise. Connaissance pratique d’une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) telle que Reaper ou Pro Tools. Fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et souci du détail. Capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies, outils et concepts. Bonnes aptitudes en communication et travail d’équipe, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des contraintes techniques à des collaborateurs non techniques. Intérêt réel pour l’audio technique appliqué au jeu vidéo, couplé à une bonne oreille. Atouts: Bonne compréhension de Wwise Spatial Audio. Connaissance pratique de l’API Wwise Authoring (WAAPI). Compétences en programmation d’scripts en Python ou C#. Connaissance de base du C++ et de son rôle dans Unreal Engine. Technical Audio Designer As a Technical Audio Designer, you sit between sound design and engineering, turning audio assets into polished, performant in-game systems. Working with audio designers, engineers, and technical designers, you will implement audio in Unreal Engine and Wwise, build tooling, and optimize for performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to grow at the intersection of creative and technical craft. 12-month contract Responsibilities: Integrate audio assets into Unreal Engine using the Wwise sound engine, from source asset to playable system. Build and maintain Blueprint-based audio systems. Develop and improve tools that speed up the audio designers' workflow. Profile and optimize audio for CPU, memory, voice count, and streaming using the Wwise Profiler and Unreal Audio Insights. Uphold Wwise data organization and mixing guidelines so content stays consistent and scales across the project. Troubleshoot and resolve audio issues in collaboration with the development team. Write and maintain technical documentation for audio features, tools, and workflows. Communicate progress and technical constraints clearly to non-technical collaborators. Required: 3+ years of technical audio experience, including one full production cycle through ship. Demonstrable audio implementation skills with Unreal Engine and Wwise. Strong command of Unreal Blueprints for audio implementation. Proficient with Wwise. Working knowledge of a DAW such as Reaper or Pro Tools. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to quickly learn new technology, tools, and concepts. Good communication and teamwork abilities, including explaining technical constraints to non-technical collaborators. Genuine interest in technical audio for games, with a good ear. Nice to have: Good understanding of Wwise Spatial Audio. Working knowledge of the Wwise Authoring API (WAAPI). Scripting abilities in Python or C#. Surface level understanding of C++ and its role in Unreal Engine. Justification des exigences linguistiques NetEase s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail francophone pour ses employés au Québec. Tous les efforts ont été faits pour éviter d'exiger une langue autre que le français pour ce poste. Cependant, la maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle pour ce poste, car l'employé devra communiquer régulièrement avec des collègues et des parties prenantes situés à l'extérieur du Québec, où l'anglais est la principale langue de communication entre les bureaux. Language Requirement Justification NetEase is committed to supporting a French-speaking workenvironment for its employees in Quebec. Every effort has been made to avoidrequiring a language other than French for this position. However, proficiency in English is essential for thisrole because the employee will be required to communicate regularly with colleagues and stakeholders located outside Quebec, where English is theprimary language of communication between offices.

LOS ANGELES COMMUNITY COLLEGE DISTRICT

**Adjunct - AY27 Multimedia Instructor, Game and Art Design**

**Temporary Assignment - Pool Announcement**

**APPLICATION CLOSING DATE:** **Open Until Filled**

The Los Angeles Community College District (LACCD) is the largest community college district in the United States and one of the largest in the world. The LACCD is comprised of nine colleges serving all or part of more than 40 cities in Southern California and spanning a service area of 882 square miles. Its colleges offer instruction to 225,000 students, annually, in 600 associates’ degree and 400 certificate of achievement programs in general, career-technical and transfer education, and contribute significantly to the economic and social well-being of its students, the regional economy and the greater Los Angeles area. For more information about the LACCD, please visit our website at www.laccd.edu.

**POSITION**
============

The instructor will teach a mix of courses in the Multimedia Game Art & Design and Animation disciplines. Department responsibilities include participating in eSports lab, Student Learning Outcome Committee. This is an adjunct, hourly, academic position that may include teaching day, evening, weekend, hybrid, online, in-person, and/or dual enrollment classes. Duties beyond the classroom include office hours. Excellent collaboration, organization and communication skills required.

LACCD employees are required to provide their vaccination status in compliance with the LACCD Board of Trustees’ policy. Newly hired employees **will be** required to provide their vaccination status prior to starting a position or, at the latest, by their position start date.

jobs.title: Padres Production - Audio Technician
jobs.description:
**TITLE:** Padres Production -Audio Technician

**DEPARTMENT:** Scoreboard Operations

**REPORTS TO:** Director, Scoreboard Operations

**STATUS:** Part-Time; Non-Exempt

  

**San Diego Padres Commitment**:

  

The San Diego Padres are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment for our employees. We strive to create an environment for everyone by including perspectives from backgrounds that vary by race, ethnicity, religion, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, and national origin.

  

*If you are not sure you’re 100% qualified but are up for the challenge – we want you to apply. We believe* *skills are transferable and passion for our mission goes a long way.*

  

**San Diego Padres Petco Park Promise:**

Our service values drive our behaviors to create the best experience for all our guests who visit Petco Park. As a team member at Petco Park, we genuinely and passionately care about our guests, our ballpark, and each other. We make meaningful and memorable connections that set us apart from other venues and experiences. Each position on our team actively lives out this nonnegotiable commitment every day to CARE, CONNECT, EXCEED.

  

**Your role as an Audio Technician:**

You will be primarily responsible for ensuring high-quality audio production for Padres games, concerts, and other special events held at Petco Park, including Gallagher Square.

  

**All the responsibilities we will trust you with:**

* Exemplifying our Petco Park Promise: CARE, CONNECT, EXCEED by proactively welcoming all guests to the ballpark and consistently striving to exceed all guests' expectations
* Operating various audio mixing boards, microphones, speakers, and other audio equipment during Padres games, concerts, and special events
* Setting up and operating audio systems throughout the ballpark, including Gallagher Square, while working independently or as part of a team
* Setting up microphones, stage wedges, stage snakes, subwoofers, front fills, monitors, FOH processors, and related equipment for concerts, live entertainment, and special events
* Performing line and sound checks, including those for national anthems and other musical performances, to ensure equipment is functioning properly
* Operating control consoles to monitor and adjust audio levels, ensuring the correct audio feeds and appropriate volume levels throughout the ballpark
* Assisting the Audio Engineer with power distribution, cable runs, audio signal routing, and stage and FOH cable management
* Collaborating with Padres Front Office employees, technical staff, touring production teams, vendors, and special guests to meet event-specific audio needs while maintaining a calm and professional demeanor
* Troubleshooting and maintaining audio equipment and keeping detailed equipment inventories
* Working with Ballpark Management to coordinate local audio systems with the house audio system for various events
* Supporting control room operations for Padres games and in-stadium entertainment, including working with the A1 and DJs to deliver the best possible sound experience for fans
* Keeping up with the team's performance on the field, current organizational news, and demonstrating general baseball and Padres history knowledge
* Performing a variety of duties, including rotation based on departmental needs, and assuming other responsibilities as assigned by the Vice President of Broadcasting & Presentation, Director of Scoreboard Operations, Director of Event Production & Video Engineering, Manager of Engineering, and Audio Engineer

  

**Your areas of knowledge and expertise that matter most:**

* Being consistent, punctual, and having reliable attendance
* Having strong knowledge of audio system signal flow and the operation of microphones, speakers, amplifiers, and digital/analog audio mixers
* Understanding microphone and line-level input signal flow and having basic knowledge of distributed audio systems
* Having excellent communication skills and a positive, energetic personality
* Possessing proficient computer skills with the ability to multitask, react quickly to live event and game action, and maintain attention to detail
* Possessing a high degree of discretion, integrity, and accountability
* Working collaboratively and respectfully with others in a fast-paced, high-pressure, team-oriented environment
* Having strong knowledge of baseball and the Padres organization

  

**Additional knowledge and experience we'd love for you to bring (preferred, but not required):**

* Relevant experience supporting audio operations for concerts, live entertainment, festivals, large-scale special events, television production, scoreboard operations, or comparable production/control room environments.
* Experience operating or serving as a system engineer for L-Acoustics audio systems, particularly the L-Acoustics L2 PA system in Gallagher Square

* Familiarity with digital audio mixing consoles, including Allen & Heath dLive C1500, DiGiCo Quantum 225, and Allen & Heath SQ5
* Experience with concert audio equipment, stage and FOH power distribution, cable management, and audio signal routing, including AVB and Dante protocols
* Experience collaborating with touring production teams, audio engineers, and other live entertainment professionals

jobs.description: About Playtech Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience. As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices. Ready to level up your career? Playtech's Sound team is looking for a talented Composer/Sound Designer to collaborate with our international team and create immersive in-game music, design sound effects, and prepare sound packages for our online slot games. HOW TO APPLY? A portfolio showcasing music and sound design work created for slot games is a mandatory part of the application. Please submit your CV together with multiple relevant work samples and, where possible, video demonstrations of completed projects. Your influential mission. You will... Create in-game music in a variety of genres for online slot games. Design sound effects and musical parts for animations and game events. Prepare game packages in a variety of sound formats. Edit and mix sound for promo videos. Components for success. You... Possess 1+ years of experience in composing and sound design in the slot industry. Ability to provide examples of completed slot game work, ideally including video demonstrations of the final implementation. Have a passion for composing music and creating engaging audio experiences for players. Have access to a home studio with your own music production setup and extensive SFX libraries. Have strong knowledge of industry-standard plugins, virtual instruments, and modern music production workflows. Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with designers, artists, developers, product teams, and external partners. Are able to work independently and confidently guide the creative direction of projects through music references and concepts. Communicate proficiently in English. You'll get extra points for... Prior experience in the gaming/slot industry. Thrive in a culture that values... Initiative-taking and confident approach at the workplace. Global scope and inclusive working environment. Constant learning and development opportunities. Active lifestyle and mental well-being. Fun and engaging company events. SOUND TEAM There are several global game production studios within the Playtech family. Each studio is made up of Game Producers, Artists, Animators, Mathematicians, and Developers who collaborate to create high‑quality content for top‑performing games. These games are then distributed to our clients and players around the world. As a Composer/Sound Designer, you will be part of our Ash studio sound creative team and work closely with Game Producers and Studio Artists to bring our content to life through music and sound effects. Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

jobs.title: Sound Designer – Unpublished R&D Product (Contract)
jobs.description: 岗位定位 我们希望找到一位对游戏、玩家体验和声音设计充满热情的游戏音频设计师。 你将与游戏设计、美术、叙事、动画、工程等团队紧密合作 。 这不仅是一个“制作声音资产”的岗位。你需要理解 为什么需要这个声音、玩家什么时候听到它，以及它如何服务于玩法和体验。 主要职责 负责游戏中 音效的设计、制作与实现。 根据玩法目标和玩家体验，建立清晰、有辨识度且具有情绪表现力的声音语言。 参与游戏音乐设计 。 使用 Wwise / FMOD / Unreal / Unity 或内部引擎 完成音频资产的游戏内实现。 设计音乐与音效的 state 、Transition、Layer、Trigger及其他交互逻辑。 与 Game Design、Art、Narrative、Animation、Engineering 等团队合作，将抽象体验目标转化为可执行的音频方案。 在保证艺术品质的同时，关注 玩法信息传达、声音层级、可读性以及游戏性能 。 主动根据玩家反馈、测试结果和团队反馈持续迭代。 与外部作曲家、录音师、音频供应商等合作，并能够提供明确、有效的创作反馈。 任职要求 具备成熟的 游戏音效设计与制作能力 ，能够独立完成从概念到游戏内落地的完整流程。 熟练使用主流 DAW 及声音设计工具，如 Pro Tools、Reaper、Nuendo、Ableton、iZotope 等。 熟悉 Wwise / FMOD 等音频中间件，并具备实际游戏项目实施经验。 理解游戏引擎中的音频工作方式，具备 Unreal、Unity 或其他商业/自研引擎经验。 对 Gameplay Feedback、声音层级、空间音频和交互式音频系统 有深入理解。 能够理解产品和设计目标，而不是仅从单一声音资产的品质出发进行设计。 具备良好的跨职能沟通能力，能够清晰表达设计意图，并处理来自不同专业方向的反馈和分歧。 我们尤其看重 能够从 玩家体验 而不是单纯从音频专业角度判断方案。 能够解释自己的设计决策，而不仅仅依赖个人审美。 面对设计、工程或制作限制时，能够找到体验、品质和成本之间的合理平衡。 能够主动发现体验问题，并推动相关团队一起解决。 对反馈开放，同时拥有明确的专业判断和设计立场。 加分项 参与过完整上线的 PC / Console / Mobile 游戏项目。 熟悉交互式音乐设计及实时音乐系统。 具有作曲、编曲或乐器演奏能力。 具有 Voice Over 制作、录音及后期经验。 具备基础 Blueprint / Lua / Python 或其他脚本能力。 有大型全球化团队或跨地区协作经验。 作品集要求 作品集建议包含： 游戏内实际音效设计案例 Gameplay Feedback 音频案例 环境及空间声音设计 交互式音乐或音乐系统案例 Wwise / FMOD / 游戏引擎内实现案例 我们尤其希望看到的不只是最终 Demo，而是： 设计目标 → 音频思路 → 游戏内实现 → 最终玩家体验 并请明确说明每个案例中 你本人负责的具体部分 。 用工性质：与专业人事服务公司FESCO Adecco签订劳动合同 #LI-DNP
